name: BIYU Outreach — Auto Email + Follow-ups + Reply Alerts

parameters.content:
## 1 · Sender (every 15 min, Mon–Fri 08:00–16:00 CAT)
Pulls due follow-ups first (3 days after the last email), then new prospects in the **target industry** from the dashboard. Spreads sends randomly through the day and never passes the daily limit (with automatic warm-up). AI writes the copy, the validator checks it, a safe template is used if anything looks off.

**Test it:** click *Execute workflow* on **Test: preview next email** — it emails the next queued message to YOUR notify address and changes nothing.

## 2 · Reply watcher (checks Gmail every minute)
Matches replies to prospects by thread or sender. Real reply → stops follow-ups + emails you. "stop"/unsubscribe → do-not-contact list. Bounces → suppressed. Out-of-office → ignored.

## 3 · Error alerts
If any node crashes, you get an email. (Failed sends are handled inside lane 1: logged, retried later, and outreach auto-pauses after 3 failures in an hour.)

## Setup (5 min)
1. Credentials: **Postgres** (Supabase session pooler), **Gmail OAuth2** (the sending mailbox), **Header Auth** named *DeepSeek* (Authorization = Bearer <key>).
2. Open every node with a ⚠️ and pick the credential.
3. Workflow settings → timezone should read **Africa/Gaborone**.
4. Run the test preview, then **Publish** (older n8n: **Activate**) and switch Outreach to **Live** on the dashboard.
